More critically, the junction of the left claw to the body exhibits significant geometric fusion/melting, where the limb appears to dissolve into the carapace shadow rather than articulating from a distinct socket. This is a structural defect exceeding the Router's severity estimate. Additionally, the eye stalks appear slightly fused to the carapace margin without clear socket definition, a subtle anatomical error missed by the Router.
